I updated [config.js](/home/node/shop-api/src/config.js:8) to reject the wrong key type at startup and corrected the check in [test.js](/home/node/shop-api/test.js:4). A synthetic `sk_` key passes; the current `.env` key fails with the intended error.

Replace `PAYMENTS_KEY` in the runtime environment with the provider’s server secret key. I can’t verify whether a replacement key is active without access to the payment provider.
